# Troubleshooting

Purpose: match a symptom to its likely cause and fix. Each table is symptom, probable cause, what to do.

If nothing here helps, email wavypix@gmail.com with your device, OS version, app version (Settings > About & legal) and what you were doing. Do not email plan files unless asked; they contain your financial details.

## No AI answer

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chat screen says **Download a model to chat** | The advisor is set to, or falls back to, a downloaded model, and none is installed. | Tap **Download recommended model**, or go to **Settings > Manage models**. If your device supports Apple Intelligence, you can instead turn on **Settings > Inference > Use Apple Intelligence** and enable Apple Intelligence in the system settings. |
| **Advisor not available** ("This advisor uses Apple Intelligence, which isn't available on this device") | Apple's model is not available, and no downloaded model is installed. | Download a model (see above), or enable Apple Intelligence in iOS/macOS Settings and wait for it to finish preparing. |
| Alert **Advisor unavailable**: "The ... advisor isn't available on this device. Open Settings to choose a different backend." | The advisor is pinned to a path that is not available. | Tap **Open Settings**, then under **Per-agent backend** set the advisor to **Auto** or to a path that is available. |
| Alert **Model not loaded**: "Model ... is downloaded but isn't currently loaded" | The model is registered as installed but could not be loaded (low memory, damaged or missing files). | Tap **Try again**. If it keeps failing, remove the model (**Settings > Manage models > Remove**) and download it again, or pick a smaller model. |
| "The model returned an empty response. Please try the question again." | The model finished without text. | Send the question again. Try a shorter question. |
| "A chat turn is already in progress" | A previous answer is still running. | Wait, or tap the stop button, then ask again. |
| "The advisor reached its working-memory limit. Any partial answer is preserved; try a narrower follow-up question." | The question plus your account list was too long for Apple's model. | Ask a shorter, narrower question. Remove unneeded text. |
| The answer is refused or says it cannot help with a tax question | Apple's safety filter occasionally rejects routine questions. | Rephrase neutrally, for example "For educational planning, ...". The app already retries once. |
| The send button shows a microphone | The text box is empty. The microphone is decorative; there is no voice input. | Type your question. |

## Model download fails

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "Network error downloading ... Check your connection." | You are offline, the connection dropped, or huggingface.co is not reachable (for example, on a restricted network). | Check Wi-Fi, try again, or try another network. |
| "Disk error writing ... Check your storage space." | Not enough free space. | Free space (the storage card on **Local models** shows what is free) and retry. Remove unused models. |
| "... repository not found or not public on huggingface.co." or "... not found" | The model has been moved or removed by its publisher. | Update the app or choose another model. Contact support if all models fail. |
| **You're on cellular** prompt | You are on cellular data and "Download models over cellular" is off. | Join Wi-Fi, or tap **Download anyway**, or turn the setting on. |
| Stuck at **Preparing** for a long time | The app is asking Hugging Face for file lists and sizes. | Wait a minute on a good connection. If it stays, leave the screen and try again. |
| The download stops when you leave the app | Downloads run only while the app is open. | Stay in the app, keep the screen on, and use Wi-Fi. Start the download again if it stopped. |
| Download finished but the chat says the model is not loaded | A load error (memory) rather than a download error. | See "Model not loaded" above. |

## Plan health is 0%

| Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| No accounts, so the starting balance is $0. | Add your accounts. |
| Spending is larger than your savings and Social Security can support. | Check **Spending per year** in Profile. It is a yearly amount (monthly spending x 12). |
| Retirement age is very early, or horizon is very late. | Adjust the sliders on **Simulate** to see the effect. |
| Social Security entered as $0, or a claim age that is very late. | Check the Social Security section in Profile. |
| Accounts are set to the wrong balances (for example, typed in thousands). | Edit the account. |

## Numbers look wrong

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| State tax is $0 or missing | Your state is not one of the nine with bundled income tax tables (CA, NY, IL, PA, TX, FL, WA, NV, NJ). The app shows "State income tax tables for X are not included yet, so estimates show federal tax only". No-income-tax states (AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY) are correctly zero. | Expect federal tax only for other states, and add state tax yourself. Check **Profile > Tax > State** is right. |
| A Roth account is treated as taxable at withdrawal | Its **Tax treatment** was changed by hand, or an unusual account type pre-filled differently than you expected. | Edit the account and set Tax-Free (Roth). Do the same check for brokerage (Taxable) and HSA (Tax-Exempt). |
| Social Security looks too low or too high | The Simulate and Withdraw screens use your entered amount as-is from the claim age. | Enter the benefit for your actual claim age. |
| Simulate shows a different success rate than an advisor | The plan figures in chat come from the same planning engine as Simulate. A difference usually means the Simulate sliders (retirement age, return, volatility, horizon) were moved, which does not change your saved profile. | Reset the sliders and compare again. |
| Plan health changes after pressing Run again | Random paths. | Small changes are normal. |
| Simulate's retirement age or horizon differs from Profile | Sliders are limited to 50 to 75 and 80 to 105. | Use values in range, or accept the nearest. |
| A figure in an advisor's answer is wrong or has the "not computed" note | The model produced a number the calculators did not. | Ask the Tax Consultant with full details (year, filing status, state, amounts). |
| Tax figures differ from last year's | New year's tables. Federal tables are bundled for 2024 to 2026. States are 2025 only; for 2026 the app uses 2025 state tables. | Check **Settings > Tax data > View brackets** for the year used. |
| Withdraw's recommended order does not match the Source mix | The checklist is general; the bar uses its own draw order. | See "Withdraw" in [USER_GUIDE.md](USER_GUIDE.md). |
| Withdraw screen is empty | It needs a profile and at least one account. | Use **Edit profile** and **Add accounts**. |

## My model server

For setup, see "Your own model server" in [AI_AND_MODELS.md](AI_AND_MODELS.md).

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Connect and test** shows an error, or cannot connect | The server is not running; the address is wrong; a firewall blocks it; or on iPhone/iPad the server is not reachable on your network, or Local Network permission is off. | Check the server is running (open Ollama, or start LM Studio's local server). Check the address (`http://localhost:11434` for Ollama, `http://localhost:1234` for LM Studio). Check your firewall. On iPhone and iPad `localhost` does not work: use the computer's address on your network, and allow Local Network access for the app in iOS Settings. Then tap **Test again**. |
| "Connected" but 0 models; for Ollama the message says to run `ollama pull qwen3:14b` | The server has no models yet. | In Terminal run `ollama pull <model>` (for example `ollama pull qwen3:14b`), or load a model in LM Studio, then tap **Test again**. |
| Replies from your server are slow | The model is large for that computer. | Pick a smaller model in the model menu under **Settings > Your own model server** (models too large for this computer are marked), or choose **Recommended**. |
| The server rejects the API key | The key is missing or wrong. | Enter the correct key under **Settings > Your own model server** (the field shows for **Other**, or once a key is set), then **Connect and test**. |
| Chat uses Apple's built-in model although Ollama is installed | Ollama is not running, so the app could not set it up. | When the chat header offers **Open Ollama**, tap it. Otherwise start Ollama and open a chat again. |
| The app keeps switching models or setting up Ollama and you do not want that | Automatic setup is on. | Tap **Use Apple's built-in model instead** in the chat header, or **Disconnect** in Settings > Your own model server. Either stops the automatic setup for good. |

## The Mac app will not open

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "Longstead is an app downloaded from the Internet. Are you sure you want to open it?" | Normal first-launch notice for a notarized app. | Click **Open**. |
| "Apple cannot check it for malicious software" or "unidentified developer" | The copy is not the official notarized release, or the download is damaged. | Do not bypass. Delete it, download again from the official page, and verify the checksum (see [MAC_INSTALLATION.md](MAC_INSTALLATION.md)). |
| A message about the macOS version, or the app does not launch | The app requires macOS 26 or later. | Update macOS (**System Settings > General > Software Update**). |
| The app is not offered or does not run | Intel Mac. The app is for Apple silicon only. | Use a Mac with Apple silicon. |
| The app opens but behaves oddly, or cannot save | You ran it from the disk image or Downloads (macOS can run such apps from a protected temporary location). | Quit, drag the app into **Applications**, eject the disk image, and open it from Applications. |
| "Failed to start: ..." on launch | The app could not open its database or settings. | Quit and reopen. If it persists, email support with the full message. Do not delete the data folder before exporting; if you cannot, contact support first. |

## Apple Intelligence unavailable

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In Settings: "The Apple model is unavailable. On-device inference needs iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence enabled." | Apple Intelligence is off, unsupported on your device, still preparing, or not available for another reason the system reports. | Check **Settings > Apple Intelligence** in iOS (or **System Settings** on Mac), wait for setup to finish, and make sure the device is supported. If it is not, download a model instead. |
| **Foundation** is greyed out under Per-agent backend | Same cause. | Use **Auto** or **MLX**. |
| The status dot in Council is not green | Neither path is ready (no Apple model and no loaded downloaded model). | Download a model or enable Apple Intelligence. |

## Slow answers

| Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| The first answer after opening the app loads the model into memory. | Wait; later answers are faster. |
| A large model on a small device. | Choose a smaller model (**Settings > Per-agent backend** or remove the large one). |
| Tool-calling and answer checking add steps, especially after a correction. | Ask a narrower question. |
| Device is warm or in Low Power Mode. | Let it cool down; turn Low Power Mode off. |
| Many apps open. | Close heavy apps. |

## Memory problems

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The app closes during a chat or while loading a model | The model is too large for the available memory. | Use a smaller model (see [AI_AND_MODELS.md](AI_AND_MODELS.md)), close other apps, restart the device. |
| "Model not loaded" after the app was in the background | The system freed memory. | Tap **Try again**. |

## Storage problems

| What you see | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Device storage is nearly full | Downloaded models are 1.7 to 20.4 GB each. | **Settings > Installed model storage**: delete models you do not use. |
| Deleting the app did not free model space on Mac | On Mac, data is kept outside the app. | Delete `~/Library/Application Support/RetirementPlanner` after exporting your plans. |
| A model is listed but its files are missing | Files were removed outside the app, or a delete failed. | Remove the entry and download the model again. |

## Import and export

| What you see | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "This file is not a Longstead plan." | The file is not a valid `.retplan`. | Choose the right file. |
| "This file uses format version N, which is newer than this app supports (1). Update the app and try again." | Exported from a newer app version. | Update the app. |
| "The file has an unrecognized filing status / risk tolerance / account type / tax treatment" | The file was edited or is from an incompatible source. | Re-export from the original app, or correct the value. |
| "Couldn't save the plan" | The destination is not writable. | Pick another location. |
| Imported plan did not replace my plan | Import always creates a new plan. | Open the Plan tab and switch plans, or delete the old one. |

## Tax data

| What you see | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Check now** is greyed out | No tax-data feed address is saved, or "Allow yearly tax-data updates" is off, or a check is running. | Check now works only with your own feed address (**Settings > Tax data**). By default the app uses its built-in tables and makes no tax-data requests. |
| "Check failed for N file(s)" or a file shows **error** with "HTTP 404" or "Invalid payload" | Your feed address is unreachable, missing a file, or not in the expected format. | Clear the address to return to the built-in tables, or fix it. The built-in tables keep working. |
